title: Without a seed, empty means null
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[] reduce ((item, total) -> total + item)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
[] reduce ((item, total) -> total + item)

explanation.approach: With no seed, reducing an empty array gives null. On non-empty arrays this would fail at runtime when trying to add null, but on an empty array it simply returns null.
